title: A-GXQ754/V2 ZEUS SILHOUETTE
summary: This Zeus Silhouette is no difference. They based on the Bandai's HG design, followed it closely, and added details on top of it. The result is a beautiful looking equipment set for your HG, RG, or even MRD.
notes: Use the MRD parts instead of HG. The leg connector might not fit entirely but you only need the front peg so you can ignore the back one.
Remove the skirt in the back to put on the connector. Remove the backpack, equip the armor, then try to equip the backpack again. It's not easy but it is doable.
body: This Zeus Silhouette is no difference. They based on the Bandai's HG design, followed it closely, and added details on top of it. The result is a beautiful looking equipment set for your HG, RG, or even MRD.

The building experience is quite good with only a few uneasy bits but no big deal overall. The autonomous flight mode is quite a feast on the eyes, I would prefer having it on display without putting on a gundam. Because transforming it into armor is kind of challenging. Or it is my fault to use HG Mighty Strike Freedom instead of the HG/RG Destiny.
I quite like the decals as well. Be careful with the large ones, they are tough to deal with so.... don't do those if you are not confident.
Yet, as you can see, it's amazing.
